name: Publish an explicitly reviewed build and withdraw it durably
description: A reviewed reference snapshot becomes readable and can be withdrawn without removing the reference source.
steps: Open Publish a build (構成を投稿する), select the first reference configuration, enter title QA reviewed build and author QA author, select bossing and budget 4 Divine Orbs.
Review public contents. Check the payload has equipment, gems and passives, but notes is empty and equipmentDrafts is empty. Check public-sharing consent and publish.
Download the public snapshot using the visible download button. Import that JSON file into the publish draft and review it without publishing; verify the main skill and equipment remain present.
Reload the page. Load My posts and open QA reviewed build; the author, skill and budget still appear.
From My posts press Withdraw once and verify it remains available, then press again to confirm. Reload and check My posts and a title search.
expected: The published snapshot survives reload. Confirmed withdrawal removes it from public search and My posts; the local reference remains selectable.

name: Reject invalid and unconsented publication on a phone
description: Invalid or unreviewed input never creates a public post and editing a preview requires fresh consent.
steps: Open the publish form and select the first reference. Leave the build title empty and press Review public contents.
Enter QA mobile draft, review it, leave consent unchecked, and try Publish reviewed build.
Check consent, then change the title. Try publishing without reviewing again.

Create a JSON file containing the first reference saved object from src/samples.json and import it using the visible file picker. Review the valid title and verify equipment, gems and passives are preserved, with no automatic publication.
expected: Each invalid or unconsented action shows a visible message and creates no post. Editing invalidates review and unchecks consent. Imported input remains a draft and the form is usable without horizontal scrolling.

name: Two visitors discover, share, report and manage the same snapshot
description: An independent reader sees the author snapshot, shares a credential-free URL, reports it and cannot manage it without the owner code.
steps: Actor A publishes QA shared build from the first reference with author QA owner, bossing and 4 Divine Orbs after reviewing and consenting. Show and save the management code privately.

Actor B uses a separate browser storage context and searches QA shared build, purpose bossing, the first reference skill and maximum 5 Divine Orbs. Open the post. Change the maximum to 3 and verify no match; reset and reopen the post.
Actor B checks Share on X opens a compose URL containing the public post URL and no management code. Check the Inspect in simulator URL contains a read-only plan fragment.
Actor B reports the post with reason Other and note QA report. Verify acknowledgement, then reload and reopen it. In My posts B cannot see or withdraw A’s post.

Actor B uses Use a code from another device with A’s saved code. Load My posts, confirm QA shared build appears, then withdraw it using the two-press confirmation. Actor A reloads and verifies the post is gone.
expected: Readers can filter and open the same public snapshot, share a credential-free link and send a report. Management requires the author’s code; withdrawal stays removed for both actors.

name: Preserve reviewed input after a failed publish
description: A real injected API failure leaves the reviewed draft and source unchanged.
steps: Select the first reference, enter QA failed publish and a public description, review, check consent and publish.
Verify a visible communication error. Check title, description, selected source and reviewed payload remain present. Retry the same reviewed content.
Load My posts and search the failed title.
expected: Both attempts surface an error with retained input. No public post is created by the injected failures and the source remains selectable.
